title: Local cycle lift for homology evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], T and J integer cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and n an integer. For every open U of X, a section φ of the degree-n cycles of Hom(T,J), and a section z of the degree-(-n) cycles of T, there exists a section b of the degree-zero cycles of J whose inclusion into J^0(U) equals the evaluation of the projection [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions] of the included φ on the included z at the identity slice object of U.

source.place: Section Hom complexes, defining differential d(f)=d_J f-(-1)^n f d_T; cycle-kernel universal property.

proof.text: Use the differential projection identity at degrees n,n+1 and indices -n,1,0,1-n. Evaluate on the included Hom cycle and T cycle. Both cycle differential equations vanish, so the differential of the evaluation in J^0(U) is zero.

Evaluation of sheaves of modules preserves kernels. Map J.cyclesIsKernel 0 1 through evaluation at U using isLimitForkMapOfIsLimit'. The resulting short complex is exact by exact_of_f_is_kernel; moduleCat_exact_iff gives a cycle section mapping to the evaluated element.

lean.statement: theorem homologyEvaluation_local_cycle_lift (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (T J : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ) : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (φ : ((homComplex (R := X.sheaf) T J).cycles n).val.obj (op U)) (z : (T.cycles (-n)).val.obj (op U)), ∃ b : (J.cycles 0).val.obj (op U), (J.iCycles 0).val.app (op U) b = ((homologyEvaluationProjection X T J n).val.app (op U) (((homComplex (R := X.sheaf) T J).iCycles n).val.app (op U) φ)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (((T.iCycles (-n)).val.app (op U)) z)
